title: ReviewOutput
description:
What a reviewer returns for one check on one chunk of changes.

There is no pass/fail field: the engine decides that from `findings`,
so a model can never say "PASS" and list problems at the same time.

findings.description: Problems found. Leave empty if the changes pass; that is the expected outcome.

summary.description: One sentence summarizing the review. If there are no findings, say why the changes pass.

CheckId.description: Stable check id: lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens. Must match the file name.

Confidence.description: How sure you are this is a real problem, from 0.0 to 1.0.

Finding.description: One problem found in the changes.

check.description: Id of the check that found this problem. Required when the task covers more than one check.

evidence.description: The exact code that shows the problem, copied from the diff.

message.description: One or two sentences: what is wrong and why it matters.

references.description:
Code outside the changes this finding depends on, like a caller that breaks or a helper
that already does the same thing. Each one must match the current file exactly.

rule.description: Short stable slug for the kind of problem, if the check lists one (e.g. "hardcoded-secret").

FindingKind.description: Whether the fix is a small code change or a broader design change.

oneOf.description: Fixable with a small patch to the changed lines. Requires `fix.patch`.
Needs broader changes (new files, refactors, config). Must not include `fix.patch`.

description.description: One or two sentences on how to fix it.

patch.description: A unified diff (`--- a/path`, `+++ b/path`, `@@` hunks) that applies the fix.

Location.description: Where a finding is, in the new or old version of a file.

end_line.description: Last line of the problem, 1-based. Same as `start_line` for a single line.

Reference.description: A line of code outside the changes that backs a finding.

code.description: The text of that line, copied exactly.

line.description: Line number in the current file, 1-based.

RepoPath.description: File path relative to the repository root, with forward slashes, e.g. "src/app.ts".

Severity.description:
how serious a finding is

variant are declared from least to most severe, so the derived `Ord`
lets callers write `finding.seveirty >= confing.fail_on`

Side.description: Which side of the diff the line numbers refer to.

oneOf.description: The changed file after the diff (the usual case).
The file before the diff, for problems with removed lines.
